title: IVG Pro 12 Double Apple Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Double Apple IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods pair juicy Red Apple with tangy Green Apple for a balanced fruit mix that’s both sweet and tart. The flavour opens with bright orchard sweetness before a sharper apple note adds definition, creating a well-judged profile that’s easy to enjoy all day. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg Nicotine Salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically supplies the pod as you vape, removing the need for refills or coil changes. Mesh coil technology delivers steady flavour and satisfying MTL vapour, while the click-fit design keeps setup quick and clean. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
